description: Retele de transport feroviar is a dataset listed in the INIS Geoportal of Romania, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ANCPI. Spatial data sets related to the INSPIRE theme - Railway transport networks representing the network of CF lines managed by the National Railway Company CFR SA. Coverage: RO. The portal shows the English title as "Rail transport networks" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-inis.
